subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but processing and retaining unmentioned speech changes privacy/security and config policy rather than only repairing broken established behavior.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Defer for cross-channel media policy
options.body: Keep the issue open as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define shared media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing trail is recent Discord preflight, config, and security-boundary maintenance plus the related Discord audio fix provenance.
